_meta.purpose: DAS nevents for the 7 ttbar stitching samples, used by scripts/aggregate_validation.py as the completeness criterion (sum of per-chunk nano_entries must equal this).
_meta.why_in_this_repo: Previously read from tempTTHH/data/samples_<era>UL.json. That is a DIFFERENT repository and is not checked out on lxplus, so the check silently degraded (docs/08 T-23 (7)). A validation tool must carry its own reference data.
_meta.keys: Validation short sample names (same as filelists/*<era>/filelist_<short>.txt)
_meta.update_rule: Only change these if the DAS dataset itself changes. A mismatch against a validation run means the run is INCOMPLETE -- do not 'fix' it by editing this file.
